doc_depths.prefix_pattern: Roman numeral + period + domain name (e.g., 'I. Social and Emotional Development Domain', 'VI. Science Domain')
doc_depths.example: I. Social and Emotional Development Domain

doc_depths.prefix_pattern: Capital letter + period + skill name (e.g., 'A. Self-Concept', 'B. Self-Regulation', 'A. Physical Science')
Numeral + period + subskill name (e.g., '1. Behavior Control', '2. Emotional Control')
Grade code + Roman numeral + letter + numeral + optional lowercase letter (e.g., 'PK3.I.A.1', 'PK4.I.B.1.a', 'PK4.VI.A.1')
doc_depths.example: PK3.I.A.1 Child is building competence in controlling own body movements.

notes: Two age-band columns (PK3 and PK4) repeat the same four-level hierarchy side-by-side; treat as one continuous structure.
